Package aor.proj3t.filters

Class UserFilter

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.filters.UserFilter
public class UserFilter extends Object
Filter class for user queries. This class encapsulates all possible filter criteria for searching and filtering users in the system. It supports filtering by workplace, manager, text search, and various user attributes, as well as sorting options.

The filter provides options to include or exclude administrators and to filter users without managers. It also supports entity hydration to resolve workplace and manager references from their IDs.

Example usage: 

 GET /api/users?workplaceId=1invalid input: '&managerId'=5invalid input: '&searchText'=Johninvalid input: '&sortField'=NAMEinvalid input: '&ascending'=true

    • hydrate

      public void hydrate(DAOFactory daoFactory)
      Resolves entity references from their IDs.

      This method fetches the actual Workplace and User entities from the database based on the provided workplaceId and managerId. This allows the filter to work with full entity objects rather than just IDs.

      Parameters:
      daoFactory - the DAO factory to use for database access
      Throws:
      NotFoundException - if a specified workplace or manager ID doesn't exist
